unresolved_risks: URL and resolved-address checks are application-layer controls; production still needs separate worker and control networks, egress enforcement, metadata isolation, and quotas.
Observation v1 does not record the redirect chain or selected transport headers.
The adapter runtime has no independent second implementation.
Atomic publication is per file rather than a transaction spanning the observation bundle.
The corpus and normal fuzz durations are intentionally small.
Direct command-package coverage is absent even though shell workflows exercise the happy path.
Local filesystem compromise can replace implementation and evidence together.
